data.title: 五和 · 病房床畔的小兔苹果雕刻
data.description: 阳光明媚的病房窗边，五和坐在床畔专注地将苹果削成可爱的小兔子形状。用牙签插起一块小心翼翼地递到你唇边，微仰着脸庞满眼心疼与羞涩。
data.location: clean bright hospital room with sunny window curtains
data.action: sitting beside bed peeling apples into bunny shapes, feeding a slice to partner on a toothpick with shy blushing sweetness
data.lighting: gentle afternoon sunlight through clean white sheer curtains
data.mood: tender bedside care, pure loving devotion, sweet peaceful romance
data.promptProse: Sitting beside bed in a sunlit room, Itsuwa feeds partner a bunny-shaped apple slice on a toothpick, blushing with loving brown eyes.
